calls.title: Change.org x GrowthBook — POC Kickoff
calls.summary: The team planned a pilot of GrowthBook for Q3, concentrating on technical integration, user experience, and comparisons with existing tools like Amplitude. They established a multi-week timeline to connect Redshift and run A/B tests to analyze results. Eric Steinle presented an evaluation framework with 15 criteria, while Chris Campbell emphasized limited initial integration to mitigate risks. Pricing discussions highlighted a transition from per-seat to experiment-based models, with a need to retain legacy pricing during the pilot. GrowthBook's AWS-hosted architecture supports secure data connections and flexible integrations. The group agreed on establishing dedicated communication channels and set a target to complete pilot setup within three weeks while maintaining flexibility in contract execution.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, pilot, pricing model, data warehouse integration, Amplitude, POC criteria
